item.title: For Want of a Comma: The Five-Million-Dollar Oxford Fight and a Door You Can Spell
item.itunes:subtitle: A hundred-year grammar war walks into a Maine dairy. Five million dollars later, we spell the-office360.com.
item.description: Episode 16. Alex and Morgan laugh through the hundred-year Oxford-comma war and the Maine dairy case that turned a missing mark into a five-million-dollar check — then spell the website like a phone number: the, dash, office, three sixty, dot com. the-office360.com. Code STUDIO50. Email theofficetechies@gmail.com (Story Time, Shout Out, Advertise, Donate).
